hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in *CHANGELOG.md|*.release-please-manifest.json) echo 'Release-managed file: change it through release-please, not by hand.' >&2; exit 2;; esac

f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in */src/runtime/workers/*.ts) grep -nE '^(import|export)\b' "$f" && echo 'Worker must stay import-free (classic worker).' >&2 && exit 2;; */src/*.ts|*/src/*.vue) grep -n 'console\.' "$f" && echo 'The module never logs. Remove console calls.' >&2 && exit 2;; esac; true
